title: Darla J NDEs 9556 NDE 9556
content: My body went into cardiac arrest twice on the same September 2018 day due to alcohol abuse. I did not intend on dying. I did not know my depression had severely affected my physical health. I simply could not stop drinking alcohol. I admitted myself to the emergency room because my body was telling me that something was very wrong. I was in a coma for a week and towards the end of the week I was in-between both worlds. The first time my heart stopped, I experienced myself in a very bad place with other suffering beings. I shouted that I didn't want to be there anymore and I came back into my body. Shortly afterwards, my heart stopped once more. I floated towards the top of a mountain. My hands touched the mountain. I was greeted by my grandparents who had passed on. It was beautiful as I looked at a pattern in the ground. I felt the feeling of ultimate joy and love as I took deep breaths and peered over the mountain top. Then I was told by my grandmother to go back down the mountain. After a week, I experienced an episode of deja vu. A few others were in intensive care unit (ICU) with me. This event repeated itself about 6 times. I had no control of time or what was about to happen. It felt like to me that I was about to die. I was able to bring myself back to reality. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: September 2018 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain. Illness. Drug or medication overdose. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) uncertain of the question How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I could hear my family in the ICU room with me as I was between worlds. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I have never experienced the feeling of love that immense. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? the whole time Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning lost all meaning Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I have never seen what I experienced. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It seemed as if I could hear but was likely telepathic communication. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes the white and pink sky above the mountain was amazing. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Some unfamiliar and strange place. I came to a dark desolate desert, dark mountain, then I was in a beautiful mountain with bright sky What emotions did you feel during the experience? fear, sadness, a sense of suffering, immense love, joy, Happiness, safe, awe Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe. I experienced love like never before Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a definite conscious decision to return to life. Both, I was asked to return and I demanded to leave. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Native American religion Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes I research spirituality What is your religion now? Native American religion Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I was in denial about hell existing, after my experience I know that the hell that exist is connected to the person. So it exist and does not exist depending on the person. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes An urge to seek questions to answers Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin. My grandparents, suffering souls, and a presence behind me Did you see deceased or religious spirits? I actually saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes There was a pattern shown to me in that was in the ground. I still cannot make out to this day. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes I felt that unity exists. I feel that I have experienced the meaning of life. During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes. When I experienced the bad place there was something or someone behind me; felt like a guide. I demanded that I leave the place at once. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I have experienced other dimensions/realities during lucid dreaming. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? Yes I felt immense love and joy like never before and I immediately knew that is what life is about During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes I was conscience and felt alive even though my body was not. I was told to return to my body. Did you gain information about how to live our lives? Yes My grandmother does not speak English yet I could understand her clearly. During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? Yes I went to a very bad place. During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes I felt universal love. I could feel it and breathe it. What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life The term 'god' feels singular and not accurate. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I am more conscience After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I remember going to the hospital and leaving the hospital Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I've experienced other realms, dimensions, wormhole Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? A pattern in the earth, geometric. Cannot make out as to why it was there. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I immediately wrote it down after the nurse revived me. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes documentaries, movies, etc. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. I came back to life for a reason. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. I feel I must share this data At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes Ayahuasca ceremonies produce similar fear Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I am aware there is something else other than this reality happening all the time. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Some people have more then one encounter

arrival.other_being_detail: Suffering beings/souls in a very bad place; a presence behind her that felt like a guide.

environment.environment_other_detail: A dark desolate desert/dark mountain; then a beautiful mountain; a geometric pattern in the ground; white and pink sky.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: She was told by her grandmother to go back down the mountain; also reported being asked to return and also demanding to leave the bad place.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She believed she 'came back to life for a reason' and felt she 'must share this data,' but no specific task was described.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Cardiac arrest twice in one day due to alcohol abuse; coma for a week; reported depression and inability to stop drinking.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Distressing 'bad place' with suffering beings; later a mountain scene with grandparents; repeated deja vu episodes in ICU described as 'in-between both worlds.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Two cardiac arrests: first involved a distressing realm and return after she demanded to leave; second involved floating to a mountain, being greeted by grandparents, then being told to return.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: She reported two NDE episodes due to two cardiac arrests; additionally described a repeating deja vu episode about 6 times while in ICU.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Repeated ICU deja vu episode about 6 times with feeling of impending death and no control of time; geometric pattern in the ground on the mountain; reported similar fear reproduced in ayahuasca ceremonies.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I floated towards the top of a mountain. My hands touched the mountain.” “It was beautiful as I looked at a pattern in the ground.” “Then I was told by my grandmother to go back down the mountain.” “Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning.”
